summary: HANSO EIENDOMSUTVIKLING AS (org. no. 986 522 999) is a private limited company (AS) based in Tromsø, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2004-02-19. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 17.6 m and net income was NOK 4.0 m. CEO: Trond Børre Hansen; board chair: Ole Johan Sagen; auditor: PRICEWATERHOUSECOOPERS AS. Also: LEI 549300FU7NJ20NSW8S34.
